subject: Graphs fail to show when published to Shiny.io:  Error: non-numeric argument to binary operator

messages.author: 50f95cc2401709f3
messages.subject: Graphs fail to show when published to Shiny.io:  Error: non-numeric argument to binary operator
parts:
Hello,
I am hoping someone could help me with this,
my Shiny App runs perfectly on my machine,
But I receive an error: Non-numeric argument to binary operator on the charts, when I publish to Shiny.io
https://ciara-morrin.shinyapps.io/Lego_Shiny_Project/

I think possibly the error is on the reactive functions
 data_1 <- reactive({
      return(lego_data[lego_data$colour_cat %in% input$colour_choice, ])
 
  })
 
  data_2 <- reactive({
    return(lego_data[lego_data$theme_name %in% input$select_theme, ])
  })
 
  data_3 <- reactive({
    if(!is.null(input$select_colour)){
      return(data_2()[data_2()$colour_cat %in% input$select_colour, ])
    }
    else return(data_2())
  })
 
  ##draw the 1st plot
  output$colourChart <- renderPlotly({
    breaks <- seq(input$slider1[1], input$slider1[2], by = 10)
    p <- data_1() %>%
      group_by(year, colour_cat) %>%
      summarize(number_of_distinct_colours = n_distinct(colour_name)) %>%
      ggplot(., aes(x=year, y = number_of_distinct_colours, group=colour_cat, colour = colour_cat, text = paste("Year:", year, " Number of Colours:", number_of_distinct_colours))) +
      geom_line(size = 1) +
      ggtitle("LEGO Colours by Category through the Years") +
      theme(legend.position = 'left', axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1), plot.title = element_text(face = 'bold', hjust = 0, size = 15)) +
      theme_bw() +
      scale_y_discrete(name = "Number of Distinct Colours", limits = seq(0, 20, by=2)) +
      scale_colour_manual(name = "Legend", values = c( black = "#05131D", blue = "#0055BF" ,brown = 'brown',green = "#237841",orange = "#FE8A18",purple = "#81007B",red = "#C91A09",yellow = "#F2CD37")) +
      scale_x_discrete(limits = breaks) +
      xlim(input$slider1[1], input$slider1[2])
    p <- ggplotly(p, autosize = F, width = "600px", height = "800px", tooltip = "text")
    ##, tooltip = c("y", "x")
  })

  ##draw the 2nd plot
  output$themeChart <- renderPlotly({
    theme_p <- data_3() %>%
      group_by(colour_name) %>%
      summarize(n = n_distinct(part_num)) %>%
      ggplot(., aes(x=reorder(colour_name, -n), y=n, fill = colour_name, text = paste("Colour Name:", colour_name, " Number of Parts:", n))) +
      geom_bar(stat = 'identity', width = 1) +
      labs(x='', y='Total Number of Parts', title='Theme Colours') +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 65, hjust = 1)) +
      scale_fill_manual(name = "Legend", values = setNames(data_3()$rgb, data_3()$colour_name))
    theme_p <- ggplotly(theme_p, autosize = F, width = "600px", height = "800px" ,tooltip = "text")
   
  })


Any guidance or assistance would be much appreciated.

Thanks!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Graphs fail to show when published to Shiny.io:  Error: non-numeric argument to binary operator
parts:
Start off by looking at the logs of your application, which should indicate what call in particular is causing the issue.
At a guess though, since plotly::ggplotly says that width and height are in pixels, the "px" suffix might be the issue.

Given that it works locally for you, what is the output of sessionInfo() and rsconnect::appDependencies() ?

I amended this and everything works perfectly.
